entries.title: Job 13:1
segments: ¶Lo, mine eye hath seen all [this], mine ear hath heard and understood it.

entries.title: Job 13:2
segments: What ye know, [the same] do I know also: I [am] not inferior unto you.

entries.title: Job 13:3
segments: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.

entries.title: Job 13:4
segments: But ye [are] forgers of lies, ye [are] all physicians of no value.

entries.title: Job 13:5
segments: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.

words.text: ! and it should be your wisdom

entries.title: Job 13:6
segments: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

entries.title: Job 13:7
segments: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?

entries.title: Job 13:8
segments: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?

entries.title: Job 13:9
segments: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye [so] mock him?

words.text: that he should search you out

entries.title: Job 13:10
segments: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.

entries.title: Job 13:11
segments: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?

entries.title: Job 13:12
segments: Your remembrances [are] like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.

entries.title: Job 13:13
segments: ¶Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what [will]. {Hold...: Heb. Be silent from me}

words.text: , let me alone, that I may speak
on me what [will]. {Hold...: Heb. Be silent from me}

entries.title: Job 13:14
segments: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?

entries.title: Job 13:15
segments: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him. {maintain: Heb. prove, or, argue}

words.text: in him: but I will maintain

entries.title: Job 13:16
segments: He also [shall be] my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.

entries.title: Job 13:17
segments: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.

entries.title: Job 13:18
segments: Behold now, I have ordered [my] cause; I know that I shall be justified.

entries.title: Job 13:19
segments: Who [is] he [that] will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.

words.text: with me? for now, if I hold my tongue
, I shall give up the ghost

entries.title: Job 13:20
segments: Only do not two [things] unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.

words.text: [things] unto me: then will I not hide

entries.title: Job 13:21
segments: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.

words.text: from me: and let not thy dread

entries.title: Job 13:22
segments: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.

entries.title: Job 13:23
segments: ¶How many [are] mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.

entries.title: Job 13:24
segments: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?

entries.title: Job 13:25
segments: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?

entries.title: Job 13:26
segments: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.

words.text: against me, and makest me to possess

entries.title: Job 13:27
segments: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet. {lookest...: Heb. observest} {heels: Heb. roots}

entries.title: Job 13:28
segments: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.

words.text: And he, as a rotten thing
